summary.text: Peter Fischer is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 44A, in office since January 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Justin Middaugh. He chairs the Human Services Finance and Policy Committee and is a nonprofit finance director by career.

paragraphs.text: Peter Fischer lives in Maplewood, Minnesota.
He graduated from Hill-Murray School in 1976, earned an A.A. from Lakewood Community College in 1979, and received a B.A. in business administration from the University of St. Thomas in 1981.
Ballotpedia says his career includes work as a nonprofit finance director.
Fischer defeated Karla Nelson in the November 5, 2024, general election for District 44A.
He chairs the Human Services Finance and Policy Committee and co-chairs the Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy Committee.
